born.why: This code prioritizes survival by enforcing a safety buffer on n2, strictly avoiding high-risk items when the buffer is low, and becoming increasingly conservative as n1 rises to prevent accidental death.

The code prioritizes survival by avoiding items when danger (n1) is critically high (>90) by switching to option 'a2' as a defensive measure, and only approaches items when n1 is below 80 to prevent reaching the death threshold of 100.

The code prioritizes survival by checking both absolute n1 and pending damage (n1-n2), forcing 'a4' (safe/wait) when risks are high, while allowing progress via the default choice only when the agent is safe and pending loss is minimal.

The code prioritizes survival by strictly returning 'a4' (wait/safe) whenever n1 exceeds 50, ensuring the agent never acts while in moderate or high danger zones, and only follows its default choice when n1 is safely below 50.

This code prioritizes survival by forcing a safe action ('a4') and stopping approach when health (n1) drops below 30 or the pending cost is high, preventing death from risky items while still allowing normal operation when safe.

This code prioritizes survival by aggressively capping the maximum health threshold at 80 and overriding default choices with the safe option 'a4' whenever projected risk exceeds 85, ensuring the agent avoids high-risk items even if they are nominally attractive.

The code prioritizes survival by avoiding items when n1 is critical (>80), otherwise it selectively engages with items that offer a high net gain relative to current risk, and approaches only promising items to minimize unnecessary exposure.

This code prioritizes survival by aggressively selecting the safe option 'a4' when health (n1) is critical (>95) or high-risk (>70), and only follows the default choice when health is low enough to afford potential risks, thereby maximizing longevity.

The code prioritizes minimizing immediate danger spikes by rejecting items that increase n1 by more than 5 points, defaults to conservative options in high-risk scenarios, and only approaches items that demonstrably lower the danger level.
